title: primulina longgangensis var. hongyao
intro: Primulina longgangensis var. hongyao, commonly known as Hongyao primrose, is a plant species in the family Gesneriaceae. It is native to China and has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Primulina longgangensis var. hongyao include inhibiting the growth of bacteria and viruses, as well as protecting against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
